news.title: Dow futures soar 1,300 points as traders rush to buy stocks after U.S. and Iran reach two-week ceasefire: Live updates - CNBC
news.zh: 道瓊期貨飆升1,300點，交易員在美國與伊朗達成兩週停火後爭相買進股票：即時更新
news.impact: 地緣政治緩和帶動股市反彈，風險資產需求增加

news.title: Oil Plunges as Iran Reopens Hormuz Under Two-Week Truce - kyivpost.com
news.zh: 伊朗在兩週休戰協議下重新開放荷姆茲海峽，油價暴跌
news.impact: 油價下跌緩解全球通膨壓力，利好消費類股

news.title: U.S. stocks end mixed after late-day rebound as Trump’s Iran deadline looms - MarketWatch
news.zh: 美股收盤漲跌互見，在川普伊朗最後期限臨近下實現盤中反彈
news.impact: 市場對地緣政治不確定性反應謹慎，觀望態度濃厚

news.title: Gilead to Acquire Tubulis Adding Potentially Best in Class Antibody Drug Conjugate and Next Generation Platform to Further Strengthen Oncology Pipeline - Gilead Sciences
news.zh: 吉利德將收購Tubulis，進一步強化腫瘤管線的潛在同類最佳抗體藥物偶聯物和下一代平台
news.impact: 吉利德強化腫瘤管線競爭力，抗癌藥物研發進度加速

news.title: Super Micro Launches Internal Probe of Server Sales to China - Bloomberg.com
news.zh: 超微電腦啟動對中國伺服器銷售的內部調查
news.impact: 監管風險暴露，企業聲譽受損，股價面臨下行壓力

news.title: 2 years ago, Saudi Arabia quietly canceled the ‘petrodollar’ deal with America that wired the world economy for 50 years. Then war broke out in Iran - Yahoo Finance
news.zh: 兩年前沙烏地阿拉伯悄悄取消了與美國持續50年的「石油美元」協議，世界經濟隨之運行。隨後伊朗爆發戰爭
news.impact: 美元霸權削弱，全球貨幣體系面臨重組，長期經濟格局變化

news.title: Bill Ackman confident he’ll win over UMG shareholders to $64 billion bid, says Bolloré response was ‘music to my ears’ - Music Business Worldwide
news.zh: 比爾·艾克曼有信心贏得UMG股東支持其64億美元出價，稱博洛雷回應是「音樂般的聲音」
news.impact: 大規模併購談判進展，音樂產業整合加速，市場關注度提升

news.title: FDIC Approves Proposal to Implement GENIUS Act Requirements and Standards - Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) (.gov)
news.zh: 聯邦存款保險公司批准實施《天才法案》要求和標準的提案
news.impact: 銀行監管框架完善，金融系統安全性提升

news.title: FinCEN Proposes Rule to Fundamentally Reform Financial Institution Programs Designed to Fight Illicit Finance - FinCEN.gov
news.zh: 金融犯罪執法網絡提議改革金融機構打擊非法金融的相關計畫標準
news.impact: 反洗錢監管趨嚴，金融機構合規成本上升

news.title: ‘All roads lead to higher prices and slower growth,' warns IMF chief as Iran war hits global economy - CNBC
news.zh: 國際貨幣基金組織首席警告「所有道路都通往更高的物價和更慢的成長」，伊朗戰爭衝擊全球經濟
news.impact: 全球經濟前景惡化，滯脹風險上升，股債雙殺預期增強

news.title: Treasury yields slide as oil prices ease at end of day on Iran ceasefire hope - CNBC
news.zh: 美債殖利率下滑，油價因伊朗停火希望而緩解
news.impact: 油價回落推低債券殖利率，市場風險情緒改善

news.title: Major alcohol distributor shuts down operations, lays off over 500 workers
news.zh: 主要酒類經銷商關閉營運，裁員超過500人
news.impact: 酒類流通業裁員五百人以上，就業市場承壓

news.title: U.S. government is spending $88 billion a month in interest on national debt—equal to spending on defense and education combined
news.zh: 美國政府每月花費880億美元用於國債利息，與國防和教育開支相當
news.impact: 利息開支激增威脅財政可持續性，政策困境加深

news.title: Goldman: Another Month of Hormuz Closure Means Over $100 Brent Throughout 2026
news.zh: 高盛：霍爾木茲海峽再關閉一個月意味著2026年布倫特油價將超過100美元
news.impact: 地緣政治風險推升油價預期，能源成本上升風險

news.title: Japan Weighs Releasing More Oil Reserves as Hormuz Risks Persist
news.zh: 日本考慮釋放更多石油儲備以應對霍爾木茲風險
news.impact: 日本戰略儲備釋放應對供應風險，油市供給增加
